days.intro: Welcome to the desk! Our funnels only work if every event is one we planned. Spot the strays.

rules.text: Flag events that aren't in the tracking plan

days.intro: Staging is chatty this week, and booking only has three steps. Keep the real data real.
Our own team tests the app on live accounts. They are not patients. Filter them out.
The big one. Patient details never belong in analytics. If a comment has any, flag it.

rules.text: Flag comments with an email, phone or card number
method must be mobile, kiosk or front_desk

days.intro: Board report day. Double-counted visits or future dates would ruin it.

rules.text: Flag IDs you've already seen today
Flag events stamped in the future

final_record.intro: Last record of the week. It looks routine. Read every single field.
